Highlights
Experience the best of the Atacama Desert while you explore the Valle de la Luna
Admire the view of salt deposits in the desert at the Duna Mayor lookout point
Trek along the desert to see the Tres Marias, rock formations formed by erosion
Arrive at the Ckari viewpoint so you can watch the sun go down over the desert
Finish up your desert adventure with a traditional pisco sour cocktail to drink
Full description
Meet the guide at your hotel lobby and then get into the van. Drive out to the Atacama Desert to explore the top attractions of Valle de la Luna, also known as Moon Valley. Spend some time exploring the Los Flamencos National Reserve to see the most famous attractions that are found here.

Head to the Duna Mayor viewpoint to marvel at the salt deposits in the desert. After this, follow a short hiking trail to arrive at the Tres Marias, which are special rock formations made by erosion from salt and wind. Next, see Anfiteatro and head to the Ckari viewpoint area to watch the sunset.

Here, enjoy an appetizer with a traditional pisco sour cocktail. Finally, finish the tour in the center of San Pedro de Atacama, a town that lies on a high plateau in the Andes mountains. Transfer back to your hotel to finish the activity.

Khoa – New Zealand
August 6, 2026 - Verified booking
Overall, this was an awesome experience and Valle de la Luna is absolutely worth visiting. The landscapes were breathtaking, and the tour ended on a high note with a beautiful sunset and some snacks, which was a lovely way to finish the day. Our driver did his best to communicate with me and explain things in English, even though English wasn’t his first language. I really appreciated the effort he made to ensure I understood the sights and itinerary. The only downside was the pickup. My tour was scheduled for 2:00 pm, but I wasn’t contacted until after the scheduled start time and was eventually picked up at around 2:49 pm. The lack of communication left me wondering whether the tour had been cancelled, which was quite stressful. Despite that, once the tour got underway, it was a fantastic experience. If the communication and pickup timing were improved, this would easily be a 5-star tour.
